title: Can I MASTER Chessformer?
summary: Second Chessformer video (puzzle-platformer 'Chessformer' by Robert Alvarez): continues from level 21 through ~35. Side-view levels where chess pieces obey gravity; later levels add keys and buttons that toggle platforms.
rules: Single-player puzzle levels on a side-view grid (~16x10) with platforms, green pipe walls and black void squares.

Player controls blue chess pieces (king, rook, pawn, bishop, knight...) moving with normal chess moves; after a move, an unsupported piece falls straight down until it lands on a platform or another piece.
Pieces can be stacked and used as blocks/platforms for other pieces.
Keys (yellow tiles) must be collected to open locked parts; buttons toggle platforms on/off.
Undo (U), restart and back buttons; levels numbered (Level 27, Level 35 seen).
win_condition: Capture the red enemy king in each level.

opponent.name: None (puzzle levels)
opponent.avatar_description: No opponent; static red king target on green pedestal.

board.shape_notes: Side-view level grid, ~16x10, with void squares, platforms and walls; layout differs per level.
board.theme_notes: Tan/brown checker background, green pipe-style platforms, black voids; title menu with volume/music sliders and '3x Window'.

current_impl_issues: Mapped to 'shapeshift' (pieces change type) - wrong. Should reuse the chessformer gravity puzzle mode with more levels incl. keys and buttons.
